properties.name: Mediterranean Sea
rules: Annex I (oil): no discharge of oil or oily mixtures from the cargo area of oil tankers; machinery-space bilge only through approved 15 ppm equipment with alarm and automatic stop, en route.

Annex V (garbage): food waste only, en route, at least 12 nm from nearest land (comminuted ≤25 mm; Wider Caribbean: 3 nm if comminuted); all other garbage prohibited, cargo residues only under strict conditions.

Annex II (noxious liquids): no discharge of noxious liquid substances or mixtures.

Annex V (garbage): food waste only, en route, at least 12 nm from nearest land (comminuted ≤25 mm; Wider Caribbean: 3 nm if comminuted); all other garbage prohibited, cargo residues only under strict conditions.
properties.note: South of 60°S. No oil, noxious liquid or (almost any) garbage discharge; heavy fuel oil banned.
